meta.notes: A multi-hop query names a project but omits the distinct hosting entity; graph links can connect project to store and store to hosting environment. mustHit is the bridge memory; mayHit is the project-to-store memory.
meta.description: Deterministic offline graph retrieval diagnostic with 20 paired cross-memory questions, 40 answer-bearing target/bridge memories, and 60 unrelated distractors. Synthetic fixtures only; not a public or general-purpose benchmark.
